sw_tagline: A new home on a desert world.
sw_description: The game opens in the hold of a cargo freighter. Mom welcomes the player to Mos Pelgo, a moisture-farming settlement on Tatooine, while loader droids carry the furniture in. Dad (Doran) has already gone ahead to run the Mos Entha arena.
sw_lore: Around 2 BBY many families fled the Core after the Empire tightened its grip; the Outer Rim is far from the Emperor's eye.

sw_description: The player visits the homestead next door, meets Mrs. Korr and goes up to meet Prof. Korr's kid (the rival), who is out surveying creatures.
sw_lore: The Korrs are xenobiologists who catalogue Outer Rim creatures for a datapad archive.

sw_tagline: A massiff, a field bag and a choice.
sw_description: On the first route Prof. Korr is cornered by a wild MASSIFF. The player grabs a capture pod from his field bag and picks a creature: WOOKLET, TUSKLING or GUNGLET.
sw_lore: The three starters come from three different worlds, which is the professor's point: life spreads across the stars.

sw_title: First rival battle and the datapad
sw_tagline: Your neighbour wants to see what you've got.
sw_description: Korr sends the player to find the rival on Route 103. After their first battle, Korr gives the player the DATAPAD and a first set of capture pods.
sw_lore: The DATAPAD records every creature seen and captured.

sw_description: At the Mos Entha arena the player meets Dad and Luke, a restless farm boy from the Lars homestead who is heading to Anchorhead. The player helps him catch a YODLING with a borrowed creature.
sw_lore: Luke is about 17 here. Owen keeps him close to home; Obi-Wan watches from a distance.

sw_title: The cartel in the Jundland Wastes
sw_tagline: A thug, an engineer and a parts case.
sw_description: In the Jundland Wastes a cartel thug tries to rob an Incom engineer of his schematics. The player drives the thug off.
sw_lore: Jabba's cartel is buying up starship parts across Tatooine. Nobody yet knows why.

sw_description: The player defeats Bestine arena leader Kitster, a Rock-type specialist who teaches at the Bestine Academy, and earns the DUNE SHARD.
sw_lore: Kitster grew up in the slave quarters of Mos Espa with a boy named Anakin. He does not talk about what that boy became.

sw_tagline: A cartel thug runs for Beggar's Canyon.
sw_description: A cartel thug steals the INCOM PARTS and flees east into Beggar's Canyon, where he is also holding Han's co-pilot Chewbacca captive. The player gets both back.
sw_lore: Chewbacca is a character, never a creature. His species, the WOOKIEE, is the starter line.

sw_description: Senator Bail Organa, visiting Incom's Bestine office, thanks the player with a COMLINK and asks two favours: carry a MESSAGE DISC to Leia on Kashyyyk, and deliver the INCOM PARTS to Ric Olié in Mos Eisley.
sw_lore: Bail is quietly funding the early Rebellion through Incom contracts.

sw_tagline: Han owes you one for Chewie.
sw_description: Han Solo, grateful for Chewbacca's rescue, flies the player in the Millennium Falcon from his landing pad on Route 104 to Kachirho on Kashyyyk, and later on to Mos Eisley.
sw_lore: This is how planet travel starts: early on Han flies you; later you get hyperlane access of your own (net:hyperlane-travel).

sw_tagline: A dark arena in the roots of a wroshyr tree.
sw_description: The Kachirho arena is a dark maze in the roots of a wroshyr tree, lit a little more with each trainer defeated. Chieftain Tarfful, a Fighting-type master, awards the WROSHYR SHARD.
sw_lore: Tarfful fought beside Yoda in the Clone Wars and knows the Jedi did not betray the Republic.

sw_description: In the Shadowlands the player learns HM05 Flash and finds Leia Organa, who is mapping kyber deposits for the Rebellion. She takes the MESSAGE DISC and gives TM47 Steel Wing.
sw_lore: Leia (about 17) is a junior senator and already a Rebel courier.

sw_title: The cartel at the Spacer Museum
sw_description: In Mos Eisley the player delivers the INCOM PARTS (for a deep-diving bongo sub) to Ric Olié at the Spacer Museum. Cartel thugs led by Boba Fett try to take them; Jabba is seen for the first time.
sw_lore: Boba Fett is a boss you fight, never a creature you catch. He works for Jabba but answers only to the credits.

sw_tagline: The rival hands over a SCANNER.
sw_description: North of Mos Eisley, below the swoop track, the rival battles the player again and hands over a SCANNER.
In Mos Espa, Luke and Camie's father meet the player; Luke challenges the player with his YODLING. Afterwards he heads to Anchorhead.
sw_lore: Owen worries Luke is 'too much like his father'.

sw_description: Arena leader Watto, Mos Espa's grumbling Toydarian junk dealer, awards the SPARK SHARD and TM34 FORCE BOLT.
sw_lore: Watto once owned a slave boy who won the Boonta Eve Classic. He still has the trophy.

sw_description: With Rock Smash (from a Mos Espa resident) the player clears Beggar's Canyon, reuniting Camie with Fixer, who has been digging through it by hand. The path to Anchorhead opens.

sw_tagline: The Empire wants a fallen star.
sw_description: On Sullust, past Inyusu Tor, Imperial stormtroopers corner Dr. Tien in Starfall Cavern and seize his meteorite. The cartel arrives too late to stop them.
sw_lore: Vader's task force is studying the meteorite to find GREATKRAYT, an ancient titan of the deep sands.

sw_tagline: The first time you face Vader.
sw_description: The player rides the lift up Mustafar Peak, where the Empire and the cartel are fighting. After the player defeats Veers, Darth Vader himself battles the player, retreats, and leaves the meteorite behind.
sw_lore: Vader lets the player go. Something about this child's Force signature unsettles him.

sw_title: Nien Nunb and the Magma Shard
sw_tagline: A pilot who runs a Fire arena.
sw_description: Hot-springs town Pirin is home to Nien Nunb, a Sullustan pilot who took over the arena from his uncle. He awards the MAGMA SHARD and TM50 Overheat.

sw_tagline: A veteran father, a fair fight.
sw_description: With four shards the player challenges Doran. Winning the BALANCE SHARD and TM42 Facade lets the player use Surf, and Owen Lars thanks the player for helping Luke with HM03 Surf.
sw_lore: Doran served in the Republic navy and left before the Empire rose. He does not say why.

sw_description: On Endor's Route 119 the cartel occupies Endor Station to steal research about the sea titan SANDO. The player defeats Bossk and frees the scientists.
sw_lore: Bossk is a Trandoshan bounty hunter. TRANDOSHAN the species is catchable; Bossk is not.

sw_description: Outside Endor Station the rival battles the player and then gives HM02 Fly.
sw_lore: Fly is how the player hops between landing pads they have already visited.

sw_title: The invisible obstacle and the Incom Scope
sw_description: An invisible TAOZIN blocks the way out of Bright Tree Village. On Route 120 Leia gives the player the INCOM SCOPE, which reveals it, and the player battles it.
sw_lore: Taozin are invisible to the Force as well as the eye.

sw_title: Chief Chirpa and the Canopy Shard
sw_tagline: An Ewok arena in the treetops.
sw_description: In the treetop village of Bright Tree, Chief Chirpa (Flying-type, glider riders) awards the CANOPY SHARD and TM40 Aerial Ace.
sw_lore: Ewoks have never heard of the Empire. Yet.

sw_title: Last rival battle in Cloud City
sw_description: In Cloud City the rival battles the player one last time, then flies home to help Prof. Korr complete the datapad.

sw_title: The kyber of the Jedha Temple
sw_tagline: Two crystals stolen from the Guardians.
sw_description: At the summit of the Jedha Temple, the cartel and the Empire steal the RED KYBER and BLUE KYBER from the Guardians of the Whills, Chirrut and Baze. Chirrut gives the player the CODE CYLINDER to follow the Empire.
sw_lore: The two crystals can command the titans. Jabba takes one, Vader the other.

sw_description: Inside Fortress Vader on Mustafar, the player fights through stormtroopers and Veers but arrives as Vader uses the RED KYBER to wake GREATKRAYT, which vanishes.

sw_title: The cartel steals the bongo sub
sw_tagline: Boba Fett guards the Hutt Hideout.
sw_description: The player surfs into the Hutt Hideout below Cloud City and defeats Boba Fett, but Jabba escapes in the stolen bongo sub.

sw_title: Vos & Aayla and the Force Shard
sw_description: The twin leaders of the Massassi Temple, Quinlan Vos and Aayla Secura, battle together in a double battle and award the FORCE SHARD and TM04 Calm Mind. The player gains Dive.
sw_lore: They survived Order 66 and hide in plain sight as arena leaders. This is a bend of canon (Aayla dies on Felucia in the films) and is noted in characters.csv.

sw_title: The Empire attacks the launch tower
sw_tagline: A tag battle with Leia against Vader.
sw_description: The Empire storms the Yavin 4 launch tower to steal starship fuel. The player teams up with Leia in a tag battle against Vader and Veers.
sw_lore: Yavin 4 is not yet a Rebel base; Leia is scouting it.

sw_title: Sando awakens in the Drowned Cavern
sw_description: Diving off Dagobah's Route 128 the player finds the stolen sub and the Drowned Cavern. After defeating Jabba, Jabba uses the BLUE KYBER to wake SANDO, which flees.
On Dagobah, GREATKRAYT and SANDO battle in the swamp's sunken crater. Leia guides the player; Obi-Wan guards the Cave of Evil.
sw_lore: The constant storm and drought are the titans' doing.

sw_title: Waking the Exogorth at the Asteroid Spire
sw_description: The player climbs the Asteroid Spire (SWOOP BIKE needed for the cracked floors) and wakes the EXOGORTH, which flies to Dagobah and calms both titans.
sw_lore: For Vader this is a flicker of Anakin, not a redemption.

sw_tagline: The smallest leader, the hardest test.
sw_description: With the storm gone, the Dagobah arena reopens. Yoda, Obi-Wan's old master, awards the SWAMP SHARD and TM03 Water Pulse, and the player can use Waterfall.
In Ilum's Crystal Caves Luke, now strong and confident with YODAMASTER, challenges the player one final time.

sw_tagline: Fear, loss, betrayal, the fallen hero.
sw_description: At the Ilum Temple the player faces four Force visions in sequence: Darth Maul (Fear, Dark), Qui-Gon Jinn (Loss, Spirit), Ki-Adi-Mundi (Betrayal, Ice) and Anakin Skywalker (the Fallen Hero, Dragon).
sw_lore: The visions are why a story set in 2 BBY can still include prequel figures.

sw_title: Obi-Wan and the Hall of Fame
sw_description: The player defeats Obi-Wan Kenobi. Prof. Korr and the rival arrive to congratulate them; the team is recorded in the temple's Hall of Fame, and the credits roll as a medal ceremony on Yavin 4.

sw_title: The Starliner Pass and the roaming Force twins
sw_tagline: Something red and blue on the HoloNet.
sw_description: After the credits the player wakes up at home. A HoloNet report about a mysterious red/blue creature lets the player name it, and ASHLA or BOGAN starts roaming. Dad gives the STARLINER PASS.
Lando Calrissian, who has been scouting the player since Bestine, invites them to the Grand Arena, where he has hired seven bounty hunters as facility bosses.
Using Waterfall in Starfall Cavern the player reaches Leia's hideout and can battle her at full strength.

sw_title: The Sealed Vault and the Wardens
sw_description: Aurebesh carvings in the Sealed Vault (Route 134, reached with Dive) tell the player to bring certain creatures. Doing so opens the tombs of ROCKWARDEN, ICEWARDEN and DURAWARDEN.
sw_lore: The original game uses braille; Aurebesh is the Star Wars equivalent (text swap, same puzzle).

sw_description: After the Hall of Fame, Endor Station reports abnormal weather pointing to where SANDO and GREATKRAYT are waiting, and the EXOGORTH returns to the Asteroid Spire.
With the Outer Rim datapad complete, Prof. Korr upgrades it to the galactic datapad and offers a starter from another sector.

sw_tagline: Passes to places that aren't on any star chart.
sw_description: Event-only key items (TYTHON PASS, WELLSPRING MAP, MORTIS PASS, ATOLLON PASS) shown at the Cloud City port take the player to Tython Isle, the Wellspring, Atollon and Mortis Gate.
